title: Some of the strongest believers in the Bible prayed prayers that felt unanswered.
paragraphs: Some of the strongest believers in the Bible prayed prayers that felt unanswered.
Even David — a man after God's own heart — reached a moment where heaven felt silent.

“How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever?
How long will you hide your face from me?”
— Psalm 13:1
David didn’t hide his questions from God.
And by the end of the same Psalm, he declares:
“I will trust in your unfailing love.” (Psalm 13:5)
Faith is not the absence of questions.
Faith is trusting God while you still have them.
If your prayers feel unanswered right now, you are not weak.
You are walking the same road many faithful believers have walked.

Keep praying.
Keep trusting.
God is still working — even in the silence.
If you're in a season of waiting, comment TRUST.
